caption: The drawing depicts a metallic jug or pitcher with a tall, angular handle attached to the back and a prominent pouring spout at the front. The main body of the jug is rounded with a slightly wider base that tapers slightly towards the opening. Around the widest part, there is a horizontal decorative band with repeating floral or star-shaped patterns. Below this band, on the front face of the jug, is an oval or circular wreath encircling what appears to be monogrammed letters. The pitcher sits on a short, round pedestal foot. The drawing is rendered in shades of gray on a beige background, using fine shading to suggest the metallic, reflective surface of the object. In the lower left corner, there is a smaller inset sketch showing the side profile of the jug with approximate dimensions indicated. The piece is signed "F. Alvarez" at the lower right corner within the larger bordered section.
title: Silver Creamer
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
